title: Pope John XXIII to broker the warhead destruction deal

tellings.quote: Cruchef recommended that in order to verify that they were both complying with the actual not only the disassembly but the destruction of the nuclear warheads is that they were going to have Pope John the 23rd broker the whole deal

plain: In 1963, the story goes, the Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev proposed that Pope John XXIII act as broker for a deal with the United States, so each side could check that the other was not only taking apart its nuclear warheads but actually destroying them. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels this as something he was told, and he points to the Jesuit headquarters as part of where it comes from. If true, it would mean the two superpowers came close to a church-verified agreement to get rid of their warheads that year.
